source_text: Commentariorum Series — Veteris interpretationis Origenis in Matthaeum. Post mandata dilectionis Dei et proximi quaeritur quomodo omnis lex et prophetae pendeant in duobus mandatis. Qui implevit dilectionem Dei et proximi dignus est sapientia et sermone scientiae per Spiritum, et exsultat in sapientia Dei.
pass_a_gloss: Commentariorum Series — of-the-old interpretation of Origen in Matthew. After the commandments of love of God and of neighbor it-is-asked how all law and prophets hang in the two commandments. Who has-fulfilled the love of God and of neighbor worthy is of wisdom and of word of knowledge through the Spirit, and exults in the wisdom of God.
pass_b_english: Commentariorum Series — the old Latin interpretation of Origen on Matthew. After the commands to love God and neighbor, ask how [[all the law and the prophets hang on these two commandments >> Bible:Matthew 22:40]]. Whoever has fulfilled love of God and neighbor is worthy of wisdom and a word of knowledge through the Spirit, and rejoices in the wisdom of God.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
